messages.content: Both generated perturbation programs use the incorrect Python method header `    def observe(self, tool, args, result):`. The actual interface is observe(self, step: int, tool: str, args: dict, result: str) -> str. Return only strict JSON with keys old and new containing the exact complete old and corrected header lines (four leading spaces). This model-authored replacement is applied once in each program; preserve every other byte. No markdown.
